entries.title: Google connections made with Infinitary's shared client end
entries.body: Infinitary no longer carries a Google client of its own, so a Google connection made earlier with it asks you to sign in again, and the Google row in Settings → Integrations sets up your own client first. Connections made with your own client are unchanged.
entries.noPicture: The change is the Google row's existing Set up step, already shown by the own-client setup note.
